description: List Kolmo's vendor procurement codes (NAICS, NIGP, UNSPSC) for government and agency portals such as SAM.gov, WA WEBS, OpenGov, MRSC, King County, and City of Seattle. Use this when vetting Kolmo for gov bids or setting up Kolmo as a vendor. Primary NAICS is 236118 (Residential Remodelers); secondary codes cover commercial building and specialty trades (poured concrete foundations/structures, painting, flooring, drywall, windows, roofing, siding, etc.).
